claims.claim: The Simcoe County District School Board is preparing business cases for three school projects estimated at $200 million, led by a replacement for Collingwood Collegiate Institute, after a Ministry of Education capital call on November 13 with a January 5 deadline.
claims.episode_span: Two hundred million dollars is what Simcoe's board wants for three school builds, led by a new Collingwood Collegiate.
claims.source_title: Simcoe County board applying for new school projects in Collingwood, Elmvale and Bradford
claims.supporting_quote: The estimated value of the three projects being put forward by the SCDSB this time around is $200 million

claims.claim: Trustee Jodi Lloyd said the board may get none of the three projects and called the request a big ask.
claims.episode_span: trustee Jodi Lloyd told the November 25 meeting the board may get none of it
claims.source_title: Simcoe County board applying for new school projects in Collingwood, Elmvale and Bradford
claims.supporting_quote: “We are excited but we are also very realistic that we may get none. We don't know what we'll get,” said Lloyd. “It’s a big ask.”

claims.claim: The Collingwood Collegiate replacement is listed as two storeys for 1,134 students at an expected $83 million, and a December 2020 assessment found 57 per cent of components at end of life with $21 million in component repairs.
claims.episode_span: A replacement for Collingwood Collegiate Institute is ranked first, at an expected $83 million.
claims.source_title: Simcoe County board applying for new school projects in Collingwood, Elmvale and Bradford
claims.supporting_quote: It is expected to come with an $83 million price tag.
